answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on devising an effective training algorithm to improve the alignment of LLMs, which can be utilized to satisfy the diverse requirements in real world (e.g., instruction following and question answering).
answer_1.outputs: The paper addresses NLG tasks through alignment training for LLMs in instruction following, question answering, and mathematical reasoning, where the model generates responses to prompts.

answer_2.quote: For QA tasks and mathematical tasks, accuracy has been adopted as the evaluation metric.

answer_3.quote: For the instruction following tasks, we employ gpt-3.5-turbo as the judge model and report the win rate over the backbone model (i.e., SFT LLM).
